purpose: Keep the recovered FU/RSVP focus lineage, AXIAL 0.7.1, APERTURE utility, Scale Lens and Two Dial as unequal projections of compatible mechanisms rather than duplicate projects.

HUMAN_PORT.job: one-source intake and explicit bounded routing

historical_donors.FU_FOVEATE: source → hierarchical decomposition → explicit fovea path → radial/path projection
historical_donors.RSVP_2018: continuous speech-boundary clock → active visual focus

shared_invariants: FOCUS IS EXPLICIT STATE, NOT A DECORATIVE CENTER.
IDENTITY, POSITION, SCALE/APERTURE AND PROJECTION ARE DISTINCT.
A FIXED READING GATE AND A MOVING CONTROL-POSITION WITNESS ARE DIFFERENT SIGNALS.
TIME OR VOICE MAY DRIVE POSITION; THEY DO NOT CREATE A NEW SOURCE.
VIEW/INSPECTION NEVER SILENTLY COMMITS CANONICAL STATE.
PLAIN LIST/TEXT CONTROLS REMAIN A CONTROL CONDITION.
composition_rule: OBJECT → ADDRESS → FOCUS → APERTURE/SCALE → PROJECTION/CLOCK → OPERATION → RETURN

gui_policy.debug: dat.GUI/lil-gui/Tweakpane may be added only as optional developer state inspectors when a concrete debugging need appears; they do not become the human-facing control language

anti_duplication: AXIAL does not become a document reader.
APERTURE does not become a multi-dimensional constraint engine.
Scale Lens does not become the universal HUD.
The modern Lens Focus Ring must not duplicate APERTURE's generic text/JSON/time/voice inspector.
Historical FU source is evidence/donor until exact bytes are recovered.
enacted_in_this_sync: Freeze recovered FU foveate fragments as a control receipt.
Record RSVP boundary-clock transfer into APERTURE without rewriting the earlier recipient-specific NO-TRANSFER decision.
Make DOCS summon the same APERTURE utility against the currently loaded control document.
Give DOCS/APERTURE/HUMAN PORT the shared route adapter for consistent RETURN/re-entry.
Expand public self-test to AXIAL/APERTURE/HUMAN PORT/DOCS.
Tighten static validation so these integrations cannot silently disappear.
return: Use normally. Accumulate evidence. Next implementation only from a concrete observed failure or exact recovered donor mechanism.
